body: ### Description Hello, I noticed that [cupy.interp](https://docs.cupy.dev/en/stable/reference/generated/cupy.interp.html) behaves differently from [numpy.interp](https://numpy.org/doc/stable/reference/generated/numpy.interp.html#numpy.interp) when `inf` values are present (see the example below). I was wondering whether this difference is intentional, or if it might be an inconsistency. Thanks in advance! ### To Reproduce ```py import cupy as cp # Version 14.0.1 import numpy as np # Version 2.4.2 x0, x, y = [1, 2, 2.5, 3, 4], [1, 2, 3, 4], [1, 2, np.inf, 4] x0_cp, x_cp, y_cp = cp.asarray(x0), cp.asarray(x), cp.asarray(y) x0_np, x_np, y_np = np.asarray(x0), np.asarray(x), np.asarray(y) print(cp.interp(x0_cp, x_cp, y_cp)) # [ 1., nan, inf, inf, 4.] print(np.interp(x0_np, x_np, y_np)) # [ 1., 2., inf, inf, 4.] ``` ### Installation Conda-Forge (`conda install ...`) ### Environment ``` OS : Linux-6.8.0-106-generic-x86_64-with-glibc2.35 Python Version : 3.13.12 CuPy Version : 14.0.1 CuPy Platform : NVIDIA CUDA NumPy Version : 2.4.2 SciPy Version : 1.16.3 Cython Build Version : 3.1.8 Cython Runtime Version : 3.2.4 NVCC PATH : None CUDA Build Version : 13010 CUDA Driver Version : 13000 CUDA Runtime Version : 13010 (linked to CuPy) / 13000 (locally installed) cuBLAS Version : 130100 cuFFT Version : 12000 cuRAND Version : 10400 cuSOLVER Version : (12, 0, 4) cuSPARSE Version : 12603 NVRTC Version : (13, 0) Thrust Version : 300104 CUB Build Version : 300102 Jitify Build Version : NCCL Build Version : 22903 NCCL Runtime Version : 22809 NCCL Path : None cuTENSOR Version : None cuTENSOR Path : None cuSPARSELt Build Version : None Device 0 Name : NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU Device 0 Compute Capability : 89 Device 0 PCI Bus ID : 0000:01:00.0 ``` ### Additional Information N / A
title: Inconsistency between CuPy and NumPy's 1D linear interpolation
